notes.title: [0528] v0.2.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Mint Notes' first update!  I received a lot of feedback about wanting to instantly convert your print-and-play PDFs into a digital game.  As a result, I've determined that having the ability to quickly convert printing cards into virtual cards would be the first step.

  PDF to Cards 
 PDFs may now be imported, sliced into images, and then imported into cards!


 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173849/89e19e8c397328939ce1336d7e1c4bff7f4794bc.jpg

 Smart Slicing Tool
 By just dragging and positioning four spots, this tool makes slicing images very quick and simple.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173849/a9dfa47eb1d2b5b3fe854d51486067233aad2590.jpg

 Flip Cards and More!  
 You may now flip cards and set the images of their front and back faces.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173849/56c3cb4c1b55fc369596eb854ff68fab8fc85442.jpg

  Tutorials 
 The tutorial and demonstration for the new features is available below.

[previewyoutube=PWeQlDeyhkM;full][/previewyoutube]

What's Next?
Our next milestones include creating a virtual sandbox where you can design the layout for your board game, and adding AI functionalities to instantly interpret PDF rulebooks to generate cards and components. 

We invite you to join our Discord to share your opinions, discuss ideas, and help shape the future of Mint Notes. Your feedback is invaluable, and we're excited to evolve this experience with you.

Hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Mint Notes Playtest is Here!
notes.content:
✨ Mint Notes: Craft Your Dream Board Game—Now in Open Playtest! ✨
After months of passionate development, Mint Notes is ready for your creativity! Design, iterate, and playtest your board game ideas with zero coding—drag, drop, and bring your vision to life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173849/8ec5d517fabe20c9b294be21b897caa5ff77295e.jpg

🚀 Join Our Playtest Journey
This playtest is free, open indefinitely, and designed to grow with your feedback. But be warned: Mint Notes is still a work in progress! You may encounter bugs, placeholder art, or half-baked features. We’re counting on you to help us refine it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173849/03946dfadd9aadee94cceed26a0bfa21d1090806.jpg

🌱 What’s Next?
Your feedback shapes our roadmap! If enough creators rally behind Mint Notes, we’ll unlock:

🎯 Dedicated Playtest Mode

🔥 Steam Workshop Integration: Share and download community-made templates.

🌐 Online Multiplayer: Playtest with friends worldwide.

🤖 AI Playtester: Test solo with adaptive bots that learn your rules.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173849/1179ed3044c61ceedc7f2f05d3d894815c346311.jpg

🙏 Thank You for Believing in Us
Mint Notes began as a passion project by myself. We’re self-funded, indie, and utterly obsessed with empowering creators like you. Whether you’re a seasoned designer or a first-time dreamer, thank you for giving our tool a chance. Your bug reports, ideas, and enthusiasm mean the world.

How to help:

👉 WISHLIST NOW to support our journey.

💬 Join our Discord to vote on features and share your designs.
